title: Retire the ticks-side workarounds the ticfac settle fix makes obsolete
body: For the ticks pwp run, ticks carried a narrow public-repo-guard exemption for sha256-prefixed digest fields (because ticfac's digestOf emitted 32-hex truncations that tripped the account detector) and a placeholder in the decision record (because settle recorded the operator's --release string verbatim). ticfac tick 4ys fixed both at the source: digests are now full 64-hex sha256 and released_by is a stable person-<64hex> handle, so neither workaround is needed. Remove both from the ticks repository once the ticfac change is merged and a run has shown the new shapes pass the guard unmodified.
